description:
A Risk Manager is expanding the risk register to cover the contractor workforce. Rather than creating new risk entries from scratch, you must clone an existing risk and adapt it.

1. Navigate to the 'Risk Management' > 'Risks' section.
2. Locate the existing risk titled 'Phishing Attacks on Employees'.
3. Use the Copy/Clone functionality (or manually replicate) to create a NEW risk based on this one.
4. Update the new risk with the following details:
   - Title: 'Phishing Attacks on Remote Contractors'
   - Description: Adapt the text to refer to 'Remote Contractors' instead of 'Employees'.
   - Risk Mitigation Strategy: Set to 'Transfer' (since we use insurance/indemnification for contractors).
5. Save the new risk record.

Do NOT modify the original 'Phishing Attacks on Employees' risk.
